name: Balanced 1 Month Seed (for daemon mode)
description: Seeds every torrent for a month at a steady pace, for the admin daemon rules
tips: Stops after 31 days (744 h) of seeding: no ratio or size limit
700 KB/s with 50% randomization gives a natural, varying pace
Idles when nobody is leeching instead of announcing traffic
Made for the admin daemon: its rules take over the long-running torrents
